name: mc
description: Midnight Commander - powerful dual-pane file manager with built-in editor and viewer

mc.description: Midnight Commander dual-pane file manager with Norton Commander interface and advanced file operations
mc.usage:
mc
mc -b # Black and white mode
mc -c # Color mode
mc -d # Debug mode
mc -f # Display compiled-in search paths
mc -u # Disable mouse support

mcedit.description: Midnight Commander integrated text editor with syntax highlighting and macro support
mcedit.usage:
mcedit filename.txt
mcedit +25 file.c # Open file at line 25
mcedit -b # Disable syntax highlighting

mcview.description: Midnight Commander file viewer with hex mode and search capabilities
mcview.usage:
mcview filename.txt
mcview -b # Disable syntax highlighting
mcview -h # Hex mode

mcdiff.description: Midnight Commander visual diff tool for comparing files side by side
mcdiff.usage:
mcdiff file1.txt file2.txt
mcdiff -b file1 file2 # Ignore whitespace differences
